units.title: Build a tokenizer from scratch (BPE + unigram/SentencePiece comparison)
One-hot vectors, learned embeddings, and semantic geometry
Implement sinusoidal, learned, RoPE, and ALiBi positional methods
Hand-wire scaled dot-product attention for one token (Q/K/V manual)
Scale attention to multi-head attention
Build single Transformer decoder block (pre-norm + RMSNorm + SwiGLU)
Stack blocks into a 'mini-former'; train on toy text
Compare causal LM, masked LM, prefix LM, denoising objectives (BERT/GPT/T5/UL2)
Build sampling dashboard (logits → text)
Implement speculative decoding + study Medusa + lookahead
Build a KV cache (training vs inference path)
Implement MQA + GQA + study MLA (DeepSeek-V2/V3)
Sliding-window attention + attention-sink experiments (Mistral 7B + StreamingLLM)
RoPE scaling + YaRN interpolation + Infini-attention
Compare naive attention, PyTorch SDPA, FlashAttention 1/2/3
FLOPs / bandwidth / memory / precision (Blackwell FP4/FP8 / Ironwood / MI300X)
Build a two-expert router (Switch / Mixtral / DeepSeekMoE)
Reproduce modern sparse-model trade-offs (DeepSeek-V3 / Llama 4 / Qwen3 / Kimi K2.6)
Toy state-space or linear-attention model (Mamba / Mamba-2 / RetNet)
Diffusion-style language model toy (LLaDA / Dream / Mercury)
Pretraining data pipeline (FineWeb / Dolma / DataComp-LM patterns)
Generate, filter, and prove synthetic data helped (phi-1 lessons)
Train tiny/small/medium models + fit scaling curves (Kaplan + Chinchilla)
Fine-tune, instruction-tune, preference-tune (InstructGPT + DPO)
Toy RLHF + PPO + GRPO + RLVR lab (DeepSeek-R1 + GRPO + o1)
Quantize a model + measure damage (GPTQ + AWQ + GGUF)
Serve same model through multiple inference stacks (vLLM + TensorRT-LLM + SGLang)
Build evaluation harness (HELM + MMLU + EleutherAI lm-eval)
Build retrieval-augmented generation from scratch
Tool use + agent loops (ReAct + Toolformer + DSPy)
Tiny vision-language adapter (CLIP + Flamingo + LLaVA + Llama 4 + Kimi K2.6)
Study circuits + probes + sparse autoencoders (Anthropic interpretability)
Red-team and safety evaluation suite (Constitutional AI + adversarial attacks)
Capstone: train + tune + quantize + serve + evaluate + document ONE model end-to-end

definition_of_done: Lima ships an academy course-leaf JSON per unit + builds prereq-DAG between leaves + runs one end-to-end pilot (operator picks). MS0 closes when all 34 leaves are emitted; pilot execution is per-leaf MS1+ work.
yolo_notes: Course-leaf JSON emission is doc-only + additive. Actual training/serving builds are per-leaf P0-P2 follow-up work (NOT auto-runnable in yolo without GPU + corpus + checkpoint storage operator gates).
